description: This file defines the Backup controller class for the admin tools in OpenCart, providing functionalities for managing database backups, restoring data, viewing backup history, and downloading backup files. It integrates with the system’s model, view, and language components to facilitate backup operations and user permission checks.

classes.name: Backup
classes.description: Controller class managing database backup, restore, and history functionalities within the admin tools of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the backup page, loads language, sets page title, prepares data for view, and renders the backup interface.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the backup history page with list of backup files and their metadata.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves a list of backup files with details such as filename, size, date, and download URL.

methods.name: backup
methods.description: Handles backup creation, either fully or for a specific table, and returns JSON with progress/status.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Processes the restoration of a backup file, with permission checks and JSON feedback.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles the uploading of a backup file, including permission checks, filename sanitization, and saving the file to the server.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Facilitates the download of a backup file by setting appropriate HTTP headers and reading the file content.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified backup file from the server after verifying permissions.
